github_code_search_default_branch_observ.note: Main and v0.31 development have zero workflow-file diffs, so default-branch workflow search observes the same workflow sources as the exact development tree. Search is used only as a trigger-surface inventory, not scientific/product evidence.

inherited_control.ci_architecture_target: ordinary changes should wake roughly 3-6 relevant workflows; hundreds queued is a topology regression
inherited_control.current_required_status_audit: docs/v031-coordination/2026-10-06-ci-required-status-audit-v1.json on agent/phased3-v031-issue26-convergence-v5 reports main unprotected, no repository-visible required contexts, and no repository rulesets; detailed protection endpoint remained inaccessible

decision: ISSUE128_REMAINS_MATERIAL_AND_NOW_HAS_CURRENT_V031_FLEET_SCALE. Do not add another classifier architecture. Inventory current-authority workflows, retire durable historical research lanes to workflow_dispatch/manual replay in a coordinated tranche, keep only the small live product/evidence set automatically PR-triggered, and then validate with a fingerprint-neutral coordination/docs commit.
kill_or_disproof: If an exact source parser shows the code-search trigger inventory materially overstates automatic PR triggers, or if repository/org-required checks make the proposed retirement unsafe, narrow the tranche before mutation. Do not delete evidence gates; change when historical gates run, preserving manual replay and exact-source custody.
